title: Analytics-side connector capabilities with their contracts

outcomes.statement: syncActivity and syncCost work against the analytics endpoints, including opaque-page pagination across multi-page responses.
outcomes.demo: Pact contracts for activity_users, activity_summaries, usage_report and cost_report are green, and a multi-page opaque_page response is walked to completion against fixtures.

uncertainties.statement: No live Anthropic credentials exist; the live provider probe is blocked on per-org keys and invite-canary authorization.
uncertainties.resolution: Only the Pact consumer side is in scope. Provider verification against the real API is deferred to the gated live run named in AC4.

uncertainties.statement: AC3 does not state how many VendorConnector methods must be functional versus conformant-but-unsupported. The built-in none connector proves unsupported is a legitimate return, so the two readings differ by roughly three times in scope.
uncertainties.resolution: The functional reading is the only one consistent with the sprint's own dependency graph. US-019 AC1 requires an invite created within 15 minutes and AC2 requires membership polling to detect acceptance; US-026 AC1 requires a daily ActivityRecord upsert, AC2 a CostRecord upsert, and AC4 confirms the live API path for ingestion_mode=api orgs. Both stories are blocked by US-018, so a connector returning unsupported would make them impossible. Derived from committed acceptance criteria, not preference; if the operator intended the minimal reading, this partition is void and US-058 collapses to a single small item.

uncertainties.statement: AC4 spans both children, so this one alone does not satisfy it.
uncertainties.resolution: AC4 is met only when US-061 and US-062 have both landed.
